description: This file defines the I18NService class responsible for managing internationalization and translation functionalities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for loading translation messages, handling cache keys, generating ETags, and interfacing with translation resources and cache.

classes.name: I18NService
classes.description: Service class for managing internationalization, translation message caching, and retrieval within the application.

methods.name: getI18NDao
methods.description: Returns the Data Access Object for translation data, instantiating if necessary.

methods.name: addLanguage
methods.description: Marks a language resource as loaded for a specific type and prevents redundant loading.

methods.name: isLanguageLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a language resource of a specific type has already been loaded.

methods.name: generateCacheKeyPrefixForLang
methods.description: Generates a cache key prefix for a given language code.

methods.name: generateTranslationCacheKey
methods.description: Generates the cache key for translation messages for a given language.

methods.name: generateTranslationKeyTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Creates cache key for the key-target translation array.

methods.name: generateTranslationSourceTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Creates cache key for the source-target translation array.

methods.name: generateETagCacheKey
methods.description: Creates cache key for the ETag associated with a language.

methods.name: getTranslationCollection
methods.description: Fetches all translation messages for a specific language as a TranslationCollection object.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesAsJsonStringAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves translation messages as a JSON string, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getETagAlongWithCache
methods.description: Generates or retrieves an ETag for the language's translation data, with caching.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesAsJsonString
methods.description: Public interface to get translation messages as JSON string for a given language.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesKeyTargetArray
methods.description: Retrieves translation messages key-target array, using cache.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesSourceTargetArray
methods.description: Retrieves source-target translation array, using cache.

methods.name: cleanAndRefetchIfCacheNotHit
methods.description: Refreshes cache if a cache miss occurs for translation data.

methods.name: getETagByLangCode
methods.description: Returns ETag for the specified language, regenerating if necessary.

methods.name: getTranslator
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the Symfony Translator instance.

methods.name: setTranslatorLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language/locale for the Translator.

methods.name: trans
methods.description: Translates a key into the current language using key-target mappings.

methods.name: transBySource
methods.description: Translates a source string, using source-target mappings.

methods.name: cleanCacheByLangCode
methods.description: Clears cached data for a given language code.
